summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) redesigned top nav (mobile + desktop), (2) ONE-TAP invest (no dialog), (3) Team page new layout (KPI tiles + searchable member table). Tested on https://evoque-payout-fix.preview.emergentagent.com at 430x900 (mobile) and 1440x900 (desktop). Login user phone=08099887766, balance=₦1,000, referral=EGVZR52, 0 referrals. All 8 review-request scenarios PASSED. No live DB mutations (invest click returned 400 'Insufficient wallet balance' toast as intended).

issues: Right-side 'WALLET / ₦1,000.00' header label sits in the same row as where the sonner toast appears, so the error toast overlaps the wallet label briefly. Non-blocking cosmetic only.

Console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' still fires from the welcome modal (InAppAnnouncementPopup). Invest dialog was removed in this iteration so that source is gone — only the welcome modal warning remains. Same as iteration 15, not introduced by this iteration.

action_items: (Optional, a11y) Add <DialogDescription> to the welcome modal (InAppAnnouncementPopup) DialogContent to silence the recurring Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: UserLayout.jsx mobile top bar correctly removes logo image, places Naturalis wordmark with wallet-under-name (data-testid='topbar-balance'), theme toggle on right; pt-16 main padding applied. Verified visually.

UserLayout.jsx desktop sidebar header correctly removes logo image and the previous green-gradient wallet card; replaced with wordmark + 'Wallet balance' label + sidebar-balance + theme toggle. NavLinks unchanged.

Invest.jsx invest() handler is fully one-tap: setInvestingId(p.id) → api.post('/invest') with amount=p.price → toast on success/error → navigate on success. No <Dialog> render anywhere in the file (grep-confirmed). Button shows 'Investing…' + Loader2 spinner during async call.

Referrals.jsx (/team) layout is clearly different from old two-big-tab-cards: green hero-gradient share banner, 4-up KpiTile grid, search input + 3 chip filter, table with MemberRow / loading skeleton / empty state. All required data-testids present.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 8 review scenarios verified on mobile + desktop

rca of the issue: No bugs found. The previous iteration's invest Dialog was completely removed from Invest.jsx (no <Dialog>/<DialogContent> imports or JSX) and replaced with direct api.post('/invest', { product_id, amount: p.price }) inside invest(p). Per-card spinner is driven by investingId state with disabled={investing}. The error toast 'Insufficient wallet balance. Please deposit.' is surfaced from the backend 400 response via e.response.data.detail and confirms the one-tap path fires without DB mutation. Top nav refactor in UserLayout.jsx removed BrandingContext/logoUrl usage, replaced both desktop sidebar header and mobile top bar with wordmark + balance + theme-toggle layout, and added pt-16 to main for the mobile bar. Referrals.jsx fully rewritten with KpiTile + MemberRow components, search + filter chips, loading skeleton, empty state — visually distinct from the prior two-tab card layout.
